content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 8

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 8:1 | "perfect-ones in all" | "who are perfect in all" | "who are blameless in everything" | Word choice | LOGOS — "perfect" is closer to tamim; "blameless" imports Pauline resonance |
| 2 | 8:3 | "covenant-faithfulness" | "covenant-faithfulness" | "loyal love" | Terminology | EMET/LOGOS — "covenant-faithfulness" is the project's established rendering for hesed |
| 3 | 8:3 | "humility, each-man with his neighbor" | "humility, each man with his neighbor" | "humble conduct toward one another" | Structure | LOGOS — preserves the distributive Hebrew phrasing |
| 4 | 8:5 | "the-affliction-of the-refining-furnace" | "the affliction of the refining furnace" | "the endurance of hardship" | Interpretation | LOGOS — "refining furnace" preserves the metallurgical metaphor in the Hebrew; PNEUMA's "hardship" loses it |
| 5 | 8:7 | "an eternal planting" | "an eternal planting" | "a garden planted forever" | Imagery | LOGOS/EMET — "eternal planting" is the standard DSS translation; "garden" is an interpretive expansion |
| 6 | 8:8-9 | "a house-of holiness... the-holy-of holies" | "a holy house... the holy of holies" | "a sacred temple... a most holy foundation" | Terminology | LOGOS — "holy of holies" preserves the Hebrew superlative; PNEUMA's "most holy" flattens the temple allusion |
| 7 | 8:9 | "chosen-ones-of the-will-of-God" | "chosen by the will of God" | "chosen by God's own will" | Structure | LOGOS — smooth rendering; PNEUMA's "own" is an addition |
| 8 | 8:10-11 | "the-tested wall, the precious corner-stone" | "the tested wall, the precious cornerstone" | "the tested wall, the precious cornerstone" | Word choice | Agreement among all three; no resolution needed |
| 9 | 8:12-13 | "a dwelling-of the-holy-of holies for Aaron, with-knowledge for-all" | "a dwelling of the holy of holies for Aaron with knowledge for all" | "a most holy sanctuary for Aaron, grounded in knowledge for all" | Terminology | LOGOS — "dwelling" preserves ma'on; PNEUMA's "sanctuary" is interpretive |
| 10 | 8:15-16 | "they-shall-be set-apart as-holy" | "they shall be set apart as holy" | "they shall be consecrated" | Word choice | LOGOS — "set apart as holy" preserves both elements of the Hebrew; "consecrated" collapses them |
| 11 | 8:17-18 | "every matter that-has-been-hidden from Israel but-has-been-found by the-man who-is-searching" | "every matter hidden from Israel that has been found by the one who searches" | "any truth that has been hidden from Israel but discovered by a diligent seeker" | Expansion | LOGOS — PNEUMA adds "diligent" and substitutes "truth" for "matter" |
| 12 | 8:18-19 | "a spirit-of apostasy" | "a spirit of apostasy" | "a spirit of unfaithfulness" | Word choice | LOGOS — "apostasy" is the standard rendering of ma'al in sectarian context |
| 13 | 8:20-21 | "the-dwelling-of the-men-of injustice" | "the habitation of the men of injustice" | "the society of corrupt people" | Terminology | LOGOS — "habitation" preserves the spatial metaphor; "society" is abstract |
| 14 | 8:21 | "to-prepare there the-way-of Him" | "to prepare there the way of the LORD" | "to clear the way for God" | Divine name | LOGOS — "the LORD" follows project convention for YHWH; PNEUMA's "God" loses the tetragrammaton reference |
| 15 | 8:23-24 | "the-study-of the-Torah which he-commanded by-the-hand-of Moses" | "the study of the Torah which he commanded through Moses" | "the dedicated study of the Torah as God commanded through Moses" | Expansion | LOGOS — PNEUMA adds "dedicated" and "God" not in Hebrew |
| 16 | 8:24-25 | "by his spirit-of holiness" | "by his Holy Spirit" | "through God's holy spirit" | Theology | Compromise — "by his spirit of holiness" preserves Hebrew construct ruach qodsho without importing trinitarian "Holy Spirit" capitalization |
| 17 | 8:26 | "turns-aside from any-of the-commandments deliberately" | "who turns aside from any commandment deliberately" | "who deliberately violates any commandment" | Word order | LOGOS — placing "deliberately" last matches Hebrew emphasis |
